method: TinyFish web search + direct fetch of the closest record; rapid positioning check, NOT a systematic review

closest_work.title: Abliteration Mitigation via Refusal Aliases (AMRA)
closest_work.author: Nathan Truong
closest_work.what_it_does: Pre-emptive defence: rank-k updates to residual-stream writer matrices plus random refusal aliases, so the refusal direction is hard to EXTRACT; reports post-abliteration refusal +2.16 points (Llama-3-8B) / +14.70 (Gemma-2-9B) with MMLU cost
closest_work.difference: acts BEFORE abliteration and targets extractability. ScarTissue acts AFTER abliteration, treats the repair as a measured operation with a price, and reports the price as a function of the support of the edit (over-refusal + GSM8K), not as a single refusal delta. AMRA reports no over-refusal axis.

closest_work.title: Refusal in LLMs is mediated by a single direction (Arditi et al. line of work)
closest_work.difference: establishes the read-out; does not measure post-edit repair cost, and does not report that the re-extracted direction is orthogonal to the removed one (cos = 1.0e-3 here).

closest_work.title: Projected Abliteration (HF blog, 2025-10-25)
closest_work.difference: a drift variant (project so harmlessness is not pushed away); still a removal method, no repair frontier.

closest_work.title: Awesome-Refusal-Suppression (survey list)
closest_work.difference: umbrella list of removal/mitigation/boundary-editing work; no entry found that quantifies a repair-support frontier against over-refusal and capability.

novel_elements: the repair is measured as a FRONTIER (refusal recovered vs over-refusal and GSM8K), not a single number
the support size of the repair is shown to set the price, with a mechanism (signed write mass concentration: 3.95 total, 3.95 in the top 2 % of columns)
measured orthogonality of the re-extracted direction (cos = 1.0e-3) which rules out 're-amplify the removed direction' repairs
harness-documented judge calibration on 500 human-labelled rows plus a 4x generation-budget robustness check
not_claimed_novel: that refusal is mediated by a low-dimensional direction (Arditi et al.)
that abliteration is cheap and weight-only (well documented)
that head-level circuit restriction fails here (our own negative control)
claim_positioning.risk: a paper published between 2026-06 and now could report a similar support-size sweep; this check is a rapid search and must be repeated against arXiv/OpenReview listings before submission of a paper (not before the hackathon entry).
